m: A *standing person* looks up at a hero's jade badge and bows: people **admire** him.
Under the *moon*, a *shed* is full of *soil*: everything is **dirty**.
*Water drops* soak the *pillow* of old Mr Shen, who sleeps by the river: the surname **Shen**.
*Water drops* splash around a *big man* paddling his canoe across the ocean to **Australia**.
At the *stop sign*, a fairy hands every traveller a magic *shell*: gifts with which nature will **endow** you.
Lift the *cloth cover*: on *two planks* over a pair of *legs*, a *thumb* points to the gold cup of the **champion**.
Inside a *fence*, by a damp *grain stalk* in the *grass*, invisible germs multiply: **bacteria**.
Unroll the *edict scroll* under the *sun* and tap it with a *spoon*: here is our purpose, our **aim**.
A *leather strap* wound around a *pole*: the badge of the Wei family, surname **Wei**.
Hold a piece of *gold* up to the light and turn it slowly, looking for fakes: **examine** it.
A *woman* walks down the *hillside* called Anna, a pretty **female name**.
A *kicking foot* steps over *twin blades*: stop talking, do it, **carry out** your plan.
Hold a *halberd* over the *grass* and chop your cigarettes: time to **give up** the habit.
The *sun* beats down on the *family tree*, and grandpa's head spins until he begins to **faint**.
Carry a *shell* to the shared *workbench*: everyone must **contribute** something.
A *woman* hands out *candy* under a *tree* while broadcasting the news to everyone: the **media**.
A *campfire* is left out, a goat with *horns* lies on *three planks* for weeks: the meat is **rotten**.
A *helping hand* grabs the runner by the *ankle*, but he slips free: too **quick**!
*Sprinkles* of skin fly in the *moon*light as a *standing knife* starts to **peel** an apple.
*Sun* glints on *sprinkles* of glitter as a *tall stool* rocks back and forth: watch it **sway**.
A *lying man* gets up, puts on his *slanted cap* and sets off, his *footsteps* keeping every promise: he will **fulfil** his duty.
A *helping hand* and a *right hand* turn the old rotary phone, finger in each hole: **dial** the number.
A *child* climbs the *hillside* to the city wall where the Guo family lives: the surname **Guo**.
A *wine jug* balanced on a *cow head*, sunglasses on, a toothpick in its *mouth*: so **cool**.
A *towel* tied round his neck like a scarf, he waves it at the girls: so **handsome**.
Dry *grass* and an old *brush handle* lie in Mr Xiao's empty yard: the surname **Xiao**.
A *mouth* gasps as the *hand* drops its *halberd*: **oh**, now I see!
A *left hand* waves at the *moon* from a dark *hillside*, alone and sad: so **gloomy**.
*Rice* left in the *sun* rots, spills and stinks: what a **messy** disaster.
A *coiled rope* lies near your *heart*: it looks like a snake, so you step around it, **avoid** it.
A bitter *grass* grows in front of the Xue family's gate: the surname **Xue**.
A *helping hand* sharpens a *bent knife* all day for a few coins: that is how to **earn** money.
A *horse* kicks the *lattice* of your argument to pieces: it rises up to **refute** you.
*Water drops* wash *animal tracks* off the *rice field* of farmer Pan: the surname **Pan**.
At the *stop sign* the road splits like a *branch*: here the two paths **diverge**.
Down the *road*, the *servant* runs after the thief and **catches** him.
A *helping hand* hooks a *bent knife* round the falling man's belt at the edge: **pull back**!
A *banknote* blows along a *hillside* path you have never walked: everything here is **unfamiliar**.
Old *scissors* and a *standing knife* fly off the cart, *crumbs* scatter, it skids at the *cross*roads: slam the **brake**!
Shape melted *soil* into a stag with *antlers* nibbling a *sprout* under the *moon*: a cheap toy made of **plastic**.
A *stone* as heavy as every *page* of her thesis: after years of study she earns a **master's degree**.
A *woman* with very long *legs*, like the basketball star Yao Ming: the surname **Yao**.
A *towel* hides in the *grass*, and the *cane* trips on it: every plan has a **drawback**.
A *helping hand* lifts the *lid* off a tricky puzzle box in a second: some people just **be good at** it.
Your *mouth* falls open at *soil* piled on *soil*, a mountain of golden earth: **wow**!
Dig out the *soil* behind the *shed* and let the rain fill the hole: now ducks swim on a **pond**.
By the *gate* stands a *mortar* with a *bent knife* in it, the crest of the Yan family: surname **Yan**.
Out on the far *hillside*, a snobbish *mouth* sneers at the farmers: how they **despise** them.
A child sulks behind a *hurdle* by the *curtains*, and every sweet-talking *mouth* tries to **coax** him out.
On the *page*, a fresh new idea, sharp as the tip of a wheat ear: how **clever**.
A *sparrow* perches on the *mountain* where the Cui family lives: the surname **Cui**.
A *towel* hangs from each roof by the *podium* in the *village*: count them, one, two, three, with the **building counter**.
A *ghost* hides inside a *sapling*, so lovely that travellers cannot look away: its magic **charm**.
Peel back the *grass* and find the *heart* inside: the innermost **core**.
Two *right hands* cup round an *ear* as the Nie family whisper their name: surname **Nie**.
A *mouth* stares at *two planks* that will not fit together: **how** on earth?
*Water drops* rain on a broken *stepladder*: the builder slumps beside it, utterly **dejected**.
A *magistrate* holds a *long comb* and a *pole* of office, and his family name is Yin: surname **Yin**.
A *towel* and a *little fortune stick* pinned up beside the shop's *mouth*: read the **notice**.
The *king* shapes jade into a *shackled pig*, thinking hard over every cut: he **carves** it.
*Water drops* trickle past a diver's *tattoo* and *standing knife* as he drifts along, glancing at everything: **browse**.
*Sun rays* shoot straight through the holes of a *skewer* with nothing in the way: everything runs **smooth**.
An *eye* snaps shut as a *claw* swipes past: over in the **blink** of an eye.
A *lying man* in the *archway* points at a *beetle*, and his *mouth* carefully tells you what to do: he **instructs** you.
Weary *trudging feet* march under the *moon*, and a *mouth* yawns as you stretch each tired **arm**.
A *tree* trunk, a wooden *roof* and an old *altar*, all the colour of earth: **brown**.
The thief begs, pushing his *side dish* across the *tall stool*: please, **spare** me!
The *child* who gets the biggest *dish* grows up to be the sage Mencius: the surname **Meng**.
